title: It was a palpable case of Doctor Fell
html_source:
From the English nursery rhyme:

“I do not like thee, Doctor Fell,
The reason why – I cannot tell;
But this I know, and know full well,
I do not like thee, Doctor Fell.”

anchor.text: it was a palpable case of Doctor Fell
anchor.prefix: aking a short walk. You never saw him any way screwed but still and for all that she would not like him for a father because he was too old or something or on account of his face (
anchor.suffix: ) or his carbuncly nose with the pimples on it and his sandy moustache a bit white under his nose. Poor father! With all his faults she loved him still when he sang Tell me, Mary,
